entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE (computational). The headline 'about 70 percent of pathogenic mutations destabilise' is a predicted-ddG statement, not a measured abundance or stability.
entries.snippet: It is interesting to note that approximately 70% of the pathogenic mutations result in decreased protein stability, implying that the loss of structural integrity is a common mechanism underlying disease development.

experimental_context.system: Computational analysis: ClinVar-derived database of monogenic-disorder missense variants (686 to 768 proteins; 1,934 to 2,559 pathogenic and 1,405 to 1,763 benign), predicted folding free-energy change from three sequence-based predictors and predicted solvent exposure; no experiment; NOT a WWOX system
experimental_context.genotype: Pathogenic and benign missense variants across many genes; no WWOX
experimental_context.endpoint: predicted ddG, area under the ROC curve, true-positive rate at an MCC-optimal cut-off

entries.proposition: The method is three sequence-based predictors of folding free energy, chosen because many proteins have no structure.
entries.snippet: We only focused on sequence-based methods because there are a sufficient number of cases in the monogenic disorder dataset where protein structure remains unknown.
